falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,200 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 77% bottom pattern match, as the prior bottom held at ~4,100-4,200; this would signal a new lower low and structural breakdown rather than a bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking near 28-30; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation beyond the referenced bottom pattern, proving this is not a comparable accumulation phase but rather a crisis event

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below 4,400
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal a flight-to-safety recession panic rather than a growth-scare bottom; in August 2024, yields fell with equities stabilizing, but concurrent collapse of both yields and equities indicates deflationary/recessionary breakdown, invalidating the cyclical bottom thesis

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
